prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one production app icon for an independent Apple gaming app named 117. Square 1024x1024, full-bleed opaque deep midnight navy background, no frame or rounded corners. The hero is exactly the text '117': three large upright very bold tightly composed custom geometric numerals, unmistakably readable as 117 at small size, one balanced central silhouette. Restrained futuristic military-industrial typography with chamfered corners, broad solid faces and subtle dark titanium material. Luminous electric-cyan plasma lives INSIDE the numeral faces and along their beveled edges, with small blue-violet highlights; the light provides beautiful depth but the characters remain solid, crisp and easy to read. Very restrained glow, strong contrast, no fine debris, no ribbons, no wisps around the perimeter, no ring, no crescent, no C shape, no orbital motif. Keep all numerals comfortably within the central 65 percent width and 45 percent height so a circular visionOS mask preserves them. Front-facing orthographic composition; no isometric angle, no tilted lettering, no stacked lettering, no disconnected floating layers, no shadow doubling. Premium minimal, deliberate, iconic rather than busy energy wallpaper. Original artwork only: no Halo logo font, helmet, character, armor insignia, weapon, franchise glyph or game asset. No additional words, tiny text, watermarks, UI or mockup. Generate the complete finished icon, not a concept sheet.
packaging: The same opaque 1024x1024 artwork is used for iPad/iPhone and the visionOS Back layer. The required Front slot is fully transparent; there is no separate visible parallax artwork. Normalized with macOS sips.
launcher: Default cover remains a native numeral 1. Player custom artwork is unchanged.
revisionReason: Replace the ambiguous C-shaped loop and mismatched floating plasma/planetary composition.
